card.name: Length units after a number, before measurements
card.fires_on: Mostly the unit word (feet, miles) right after a number giving a depth, distance or height, such as wells 380 feet deep. It also fires on small linking words in sentences about typical amounts or limits.

modes.label: Distance units after a number
modes.description: The word feet or miles directly after a figure describing depth, height or distance.
modes.example: Two wells are 380<< feet>> deep, 20 inches in diameter

modes.label: Linking words near quantities
modes.description: A small word such as it, in, an or not just before a stated amount or typical rate.
modes.example: In adult life<< it>> beats a little oftener than once a

card.writes: It promotes the word average and its variants, suggesting a typical or mean value may follow.
card.plain: It fires on units like feet or miles after a number and nudges the model toward words like average.
